## Previous Blooms

Monthly images of chlorophyll between 20° to 35°N, 160° to 130°W for July, August, Sepember and October of the selected year (July & Aug images not available for 1997).

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: 'asis'

lastdate <- get_dataset_max_date(satdata$dset[length(satdata$dset)])
currentinfo <- gettimes(lastdate,months,satdata)

thisyear <- currentinfo$thisyear
yrmin <- min(satdata$yrmin)
years <- seq(from = yrmin, to = thisyear, by = 1)
ojs_define(thisyear = thisyear)
ojs_define(years = years)
```


```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof selectedYr = Inputs.select(years, {
  value: thisyear-1,
  label: "Year:",
  format: x => x.toString(),
  width:100
})


```


```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Data Definitions
satdata = [
  { id: "0", name: "SeaWiFS", dset: "erdSW2018chlamday", varname: "chlorophyll", yrmin: 1997, yrmax: 2002, hasalt: false },
  { id: "1", name: "MODIS", dset: "erdMH1chlamday", varname: "chlorophyll", yrmin: 2003, yrmax: 2011, hasalt: false },
  { id: "2", name: "NOAA VIIRS", dset: "nesdisVHNSQchlaMonthly", varname: "chlor_a", yrmin: 2012, yrmax: 2050, hasalt: true }
]

satwkdata = ({
  id: "0",
  name: "NOAA VIIRS Near Real-Time Weekly Chlorophyll",
  dset: "nesdisVHNchlaWeekly",
  varname: "chlor_a",
  yrmin: 2018,
  yrmax: 2050,
  hasalt: true
})

months = [
  { id: "07", name: "Jul" },
  { id: "08", name: "Aug" },
  { id: "09", name: "Sep" },
  { id: "10", name: "Oct" }
]

// Function 1: getsaturl
function getsaturl(yr, mon, fmt, lgnd, satdata) {
  if (satdata && satdata.length > 0) {
    let satid = null;
    
    // Find matching satellite data index
    for (let i = 0; i < satdata.length; i++) {
      if (yr <= satdata[i].yrmax && yr >= satdata[i].yrmin) {
        satid = i;
      }
    }
    
    if (satid === null) {
      console.warn("No satellite dataset found matching the given year.");
      return null;
    }
    
    const erddata = satdata[satid];
    const start_url = "https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/griddap/";
    
    // Format month to 2 digits with leading zero
    const mon_str = String(parseInt(mon, 10)).padStart(2, '0');
    const time_str = `[(${yr}-${mon_str}-01T12:00:00Z)]`;
    
    const alt_str = erddata.hasalt ? "[(0.0)]" : "";
    const loc_str = "[(35):(20)][(-160):(-130)]&.draw=surface&.vars=longitude%7Clatitude%7C";
    const end_str = "&.colorBar=%7C%7CLinear%7C0%7C0.2%7C&.bgColor=0xffccccff&.trim=0";
    
    let url = `${start_url}${erddata.dset}.${fmt}?${erddata.varname}${time_str}${alt_str}${loc_str}${erddata.varname}${end_str}`;
    
    if (lgnd !== 1) {
      url += "&.legend=Off";
    }
    return url;
  }
}

// Function 2: getweeklyurl
function getweeklyurl(fmt, lgnd, satwkdata) {
  const erddata = satwkdata;
  
  if (erddata && erddata.dset) {
    const start_url = "https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/griddap/";
    const time_str = "[(last)]";
    const alt_str = erddata.hasalt ? "[(0.0)]" : "";
    const loc_str = "[(35):(20)][(-160):(-130)]&.draw=surface&.vars=longitude%7Clatitude%7C";
    const end_str = "&.colorBar=%7C%7CLinear%7C0%7C0.2%7C&.bgColor=0xffccccff&.trim=0";
    
    let url = `${start_url}${erddata.dset}.${fmt}?${erddata.varname}${time_str}${alt_str}${loc_str}${erddata.varname}${end_str}`;
    
    if (lgnd !== 1) {
      url += "&.legend=Off";
    }
    
    return url;
  }
}

```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

curmonths = (selectedYr == 1997) 
  ? months.filter(mon => parseInt(mon.id) >= 9) 
  : months

html`<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 20px; align-items: flex-start;">
${curmonths.map(mon => {
  const url = getsaturl(selectedYr, mon.id, "png", 1, satdata);
  const dataurl = getsaturl(selectedYr, mon.id, "graph", 1, satdata);
  const label = mon.name ? mon.name : `Month ${mon.id}`; // Uses mon.name or falls back to ID
  
  return html`
    <divstyle="flex: 1 1 200px; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;">
      <h3>${label} ${selectedYr}</h3>
      <img src="${url}" /><br>
      <span><a href="${dataurl}" target="_blank">ERDDAP&#8482; download</a></span>
    </div>
  `;
})}
</div>
`

```
